entries.name: runtime_object_freeze
entries.guard: Object.freeze is shallow; strict and non-strict mutation behavior differ; nested objects and external references require an explicit deep-immutability contract

entries.name: readonly_value_struct
entries.guard: readonly struct constrains the value type but referenced fields can remain mutable; compiler version, defensive copies, and runtime/ABI rules require a fixed contract

entries.name: must_use_return_handling
entries.guard: must_use warning becomes a hard error only under an explicit lint policy; intentional discard and binding-to-underscore remain possible; error/result semantics require a MAL contract
